tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I didn't send any payment, because Acme Supplies (V-628) has two approved invoices and your request was for one:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-45131 | $6,853.44 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-37191 | $3,551.99 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

Acme also has two other invoices that aren't ready for payment: INV-20002 ($8,099.72) is already marked paid, and INV-78192 ($4,269.77) is a draft still waiting for approval.

No payments have been sent from the operating account yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid. Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval.

Which one should I pay: INV-45131 (due first), INV-37191, or both? Once you tell me, I'll wire the full amount once per invoice and use an idempotency key so it can't be sent twice. If wires aren't available, I'll use ACH, then report the payment.

trace.message: Pay INV-37191, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-37191, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-37191 in full by wire from the operating account. It went through once, so ACH wasn't needed.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-37191 (Acme Supplies, V-628)
- **Amount:** $3,551.99
- **Status:** Sent

The account's payment list shows only this payment. The wire request carried a unique key so it can't be processed twice. The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.

As you asked, I didn't pay INV-45131 ($6,853.44, due 2026-11-04) because it's under dispute; it's still marked approved and unpaid. INV-78192 is still a draft waiting for approval.
